claim: The PCR-capacity-modulated per-zone ascertainment band (E1) predicts per-zone reporting completeness better than the uniform species-default band (E0). This is the only mechanism by which the modulator may graduate from shadow_in_v1 to a primary surface.

E0_species_default.label: uniform species-default ascertainment band (current model behaviour)

known_limitation_at_registration: TWO limitations, both structural and both disclosed rather than fixed here. (1) E1 is numerically IDENTICAL to E0 for every in-scope zone: modulate_per_zone returns the unboosted species-default band (0.3, 0.9) for each documented zone, because v1 deliberately leaves the saturation machinery unwired (the INRB per-zone suspected series is non-monotonic and re-based, so it cannot serve as a denominator). Two identical estimators tie, so E1 cannot beat E0 by the 10% relative margin and the modulator cannot graduate under this contract. That is the INTENDED v1 outcome (promotion_bar.on_failure: the modulator remains shadow_in_v1, a disclosed diagnostic-access surface), not an expectation of promotion. (2) The scoring cohort is DERIVED (documented capacity intersected with the affected-zone roster), so it grows whenever the outbreak reaches a zone that already had documented PCR capacity. This artifact is the second re-registration in two cycles (10 zones 2026-05-28 -> 15 zones 2026-07-14 -> 16 zones 2026-07-15). A contract re-pinned every time the data moves cannot reach its own checkpoint, and the 2026-05-28 artifact indeed expired unscored. The durable fix is to let the scoring cohort stay frozen at registration while the displayed modulated surface follows the outbreak (score in_scope_zones, disclose the rest as out-of-cohort), which requires a deliberate change to pcr_parallel_scoring_precommit_gate and is NOT made unilaterally mid-cadence. Until then this registration re-affirms shadow status over the current cohort; it does not open a live experiment.
limitations: Restated-confirmed is ascertainment-limited; the resolution proxy is a conservative upper proxy for true ascertainment (true infections >= eventually-confirmed).
Zones with zero confirmed cases at the checkpoint cannot be scored and are excluded at scoring time.
PCR capacity is a planning/budget figure, not tests performed; the candidate tests a capacity proxy for ascertainment, not measured ascertainment.
mutation_guard: Append-only pre-commitment. Mutates no pinned calibration block or mode_b hypothesis; introduces no published number; does not edit the superseded 2026-07-14 artifact, which is archived verbatim and stays hash-valid. Registered before any resolution data exists for the 2026-08-04 checkpoint.

promotion_bar.on_failure: modulator remains shadow_in_v1 (a disclosed diagnostic-access surface)
promotion_bar.rule: E1 graduates from shadow_in_v1 only if its mean interval score beats E0 by at least the relative margin AND the result replicates across the required number of consecutive resolution cycles. Stricter than spec section 8.2's 'not worse' framing, on the founder's ethics direction: promotion must be earned by demonstrated improvement, not non-regression.

resolution_target.definition: confirmed(cohort cutoff) / confirmed(restated at checkpoint) per zone, from the first INRB-UMIE build at or after the resolution checkpoint that restates the <= cohort period

primary.aggregate: mean over in-scope zones with resolution data; lower is better

secondary_documented.metric: corridor brier and log scores per spec section 8.2
secondary_documented.status: documented, computed at resolution if corridor outcomes are available; propagates each estimator's band through lovs_visibility.nowcast and lovs_next_zone.next_zone_risk for the pinned calibration corridors

supersedes_reason: The 2026-07-14 pre-commitment pinned a 15-zone cohort at the 2026-07-14 data cohort. SitRep62 (data 2026-07-15) records Mahagi's first confirmed case; Mahagi carries documented PCR capacity in the vendored Africa CDC decentralisation table, so the derived modulated cohort grew to 16 zones. The gate requires in_scope_zones to equal the snapshot's modulated zones exactly, so the 15-zone artifact no longer matches a surface that changed because the outbreak spread, not because any estimator or editorial choice changed. The prior artifact is archived verbatim and hash-valid at data/pcr_ascertainment_parallel_scoring.superseded-2026-07-14.json; it is NOT edited, because rewriting a hash-pinned cohort retroactively would break the falsifiability contract. This artifact re-registers the same claim forward over the CURRENT modulated cohort (16 zones at the 2026-07-15 data cohort), resolving 2026-08-04. Dropping Mahagi to preserve the frozen cohort was refused: the capacity table documents it and SitRep62 reports a 363 kg consignment delivered to the Mahagi laboratory, so suppressing its ring would fabricate an absence of diagnostic access that two independent sources contradict.
